info.title: Ridder
info.description: Rule Inspector for Dependency Diagrams, Exceptions, and Reports. Interactive and headless architecture tooling for RonSijm.AnaalIJzer.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file to load with MSBuildWorkspace.

options.name: --config
options.description: XML settings file to document without loading a project.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file or directory. Defaults to an input-local path.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: MSBuild configuration. Defaults to Release.

options.name: --strategy
options.description: Config generation: snapshot or conventions. Defaults to snapshot.

options.name: --minimum-confidence
options.description: Convention confidence from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.90.

options.name: --minimum-support
options.description:
Convention caller count. Defaults to 5.
--include-code-evidence Include rule matches and violations in project documentation.

options.name: --include-input
options.description:
Include the input architecture XML in generated documentation.
--generate-documentation Generate code-backed documentation with a new configuration.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite an existing output file.
Aliases:
scaffold-config -> generate-config
docs, generate-documentation -> documentation
generate-report -> report
validate, doctor, health -> inspect
merge -> merge-config
split -> split-config
